rca_of_the_issue.finding: Backend subscription endpoints are working correctly
possible_customer_issue_causes: 1. RevenueCat webhook not firing to backend (check RevenueCat webhook delivery logs)
2. Frontend not calling /api/subscription/sync after purchase/restore (check PaywallScreen.tsx handlePurchase/handleRestore)
3. RevenueCat entitlement not being detected correctly in app (check syncRevenueCatWithBackend in index.tsx)
4. Customer's RevenueCat subscription may have expired or been cancelled
5. Network issues preventing frontend from reaching backend sync endpoint
recommended_debugging_steps: 1. Check RevenueCat dashboard for customer's subscription status
2. Check RevenueCat webhook delivery logs for any failed deliveries
3. Have customer check their Apple subscription status in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions
4. Add logging to frontend syncRevenueCatWithBackend function to debug
5. Check backend logs for any sync requests from the customer's user_id
